name: The Fool
description: Pure potential, fresh starts, and taking a leap of faith into the unknown. The Fool trusts the journey before knowing where it leads.

name: The Magician
description: The power to turn ideas into reality. You have every tool you need, and the Magician asks you to focus your will and begin.

name: The High Priestess
description: The quiet voice of intuition and the knowledge that sits beneath the surface. She asks you to listen inward before acting.

name: The Empress
description: Creativity, abundance, and nurturing in full bloom. She represents growth, comfort, and the richness of the senses.

name: The Emperor
description: Order, structure, and steady authority. The Emperor builds foundations and sets boundaries so that things can last.

name: The Hierophant
description: Tradition, shared belief, and learning from established wisdom. He represents teachers, institutions, and the comfort of known paths.

name: The Lovers
description: A meaningful union and the choices that reveal your values. Beyond romance, it is about alignment and choosing with your whole self.

name: The Chariot
description: Determination and victory through discipline. The Chariot drives forward by holding opposing forces under one clear direction.

name: Strength
description: Gentle courage rather than brute force. It shows mastery of difficult emotions through patience and compassion.

name: The Hermit
description: A deliberate retreat to look within. The Hermit carries a small light of insight gained through solitude and reflection.

name: Wheel of Fortune
description: Life's cycles turning: luck, change, and fate in motion. What rises will fall and rise again, so adaptability matters.

name: Justice
description: Fairness, truth, and accountability. Every action carries consequences, and Justice asks for honest judgment.

name: The Hanged Man
description: A willing pause and surrender that brings a new point of view. Letting go of control reveals what pushing harder could not.

name: Death
description: Rarely literal, Death marks an ending that clears space for something new. Transformation requires releasing what has run its course.

name: Temperance
description: Balance, moderation, and blending opposites into harmony. It calls for patience and a steady, measured approach.

name: The Devil
description: The chains we place on ourselves through habit, desire, or fear. The Devil shows what binds you, and that the chains are looser than they look.

name: The Tower
description: Sudden disruption that shatters false structures. It is painful, but it clears the ground for something more honest.

name: The Star
description: Hope and renewal after hardship. The Star offers calm, healing, and faith that things are getting better.

name: The Moon
description: The realm of dreams, illusion, and the unconscious. Things are not yet clear, so move carefully and trust your instincts.

name: The Sun
description: Joy, warmth, and clarity. The Sun brings success, vitality, and the simple pleasure of things going well.

name: Judgement
description: A moment of reckoning and awakening. You are called to reflect on the past, forgive, and rise into a new chapter.

name: The World
description: Completion, wholeness, and the satisfaction of a cycle fulfilled. You have arrived, and a new journey is ready to begin.

name: Ace of Wands
upright: a spark of inspiration, ready to act
description: The raw spark of a new idea, passion, or venture. It is an invitation to act on inspiration while the energy is fresh.

name: Two of Wands
reversed: fear of the unknown, poor planning
description: Standing at a threshold with the world ahead of you. You hold some success already and must decide how far to venture next.

name: Three of Wands
description: Plans in motion and ships on the horizon. Early efforts begin to pay off and the view widens.

name: Four of Wands
description: A joyful milestone worth celebrating with others. It speaks of stability, home, and shared happiness.

name: Five of Wands
description: A scramble of competing egos and ideas. The conflict is lively rather than deadly, and it can sharpen everyone involved.

name: Six of Wands
description: Public victory and recognition earned through effort. Confidence is high, though it rests partly on the regard of others.

name: Seven of Wands
description: Defending your position from higher ground. You face challengers, and holding firm is the task.

name: Eight of Wands
description: Things moving quickly, messages flying, and momentum at its peak. Delay ends and action comes fast.

name: Nine of Wands
description: Weary but still standing, nearly at the finish. Past battles have made you cautious, yet you have endurance left.

name: Ten of Wands
description: Carrying a heavy load of obligations. Success has brought responsibility, and it may be time to ask what you can set down.

name: Page of Wands
upright: curiosity, a message on its way
description: An eager messenger bringing a spark of curiosity. This is the explorer who is excited to try something new.

name: Knight of Wands
description: Fiery energy charging toward a goal. He is bold and adventurous, but can act before thinking.

name: Queen of Wands
description: Warm, magnetic, and self-assured. She leads by inspiring others and embracing her own passion.

name: King of Wands
description: A visionary leader who turns big ideas into action. He commands with charisma and a clear sense of purpose.

name: Ace of Cups
description: An overflowing cup of new feeling, whether love, creativity, or compassion. Emotional doors begin to open.

name: Two of Cups
description: Two people meeting as equals in mutual attraction and respect. It speaks of partnership built on real connection.

name: Three of Cups
description: Friends raising a glass together. It celebrates community, joy, and shared good news.

name: Four of Cups
description: Disengagement and contemplation while an offer goes unnoticed. Boredom or discontent can blind you to what is available.

name: Five of Cups
description: Grief over what has spilled, while two cups still stand behind. It acknowledges loss and the choice of where to look next.

name: Six of Cups
description: Tender memories and innocent kindness from the past. It can bring reunions, gifts, and a longing for simpler days.

name: Seven of Cups
description: A cloud of tempting options and daydreams. Not everything on offer is real, so discernment is needed.

name: Eight of Cups
reversed: fear of change, staying too long
description: Walking away from something that no longer fulfills you, even though it took effort to build. The search for deeper meaning begins.

name: Nine of Cups
description: Contentment and a wish granted. It is often called the wish card, a moment to enjoy what you have earned.

name: Ten of Cups
description: Emotional fulfillment shared with those you love. It paints a picture of harmony, belonging, and a happy home.

name: Page of Cups
upright: an emotional message, a creative start
description: A gentle messenger of feeling and imagination. This card invites openness, creativity, and trusting a sudden intuition.

name: Knight of Cups
upright: a romantic offer, following the heart
description: A romantic dreamer who follows the heart. He arrives with an offer or invitation, charming and sincere.

name: Queen of Cups
description: Deep empathy and emotional wisdom. She nurtures others while staying connected to her own inner waters.

name: King of Cups
description: Mastery over emotions, balancing feeling with calm judgment. He offers steady counsel and generous understanding.

name: Ace of Swords
description: A flash of clarity cutting through confusion. It is the triumph of truth, a fresh idea, or a decisive insight.

name: Two of Swords
description: A blindfolded figure holding two swords in uneasy balance. A decision is being avoided, and the peace is only surface deep.

name: Three of Swords
description: A heart pierced by painful truth. It speaks of grief and heartbreak, and of the healing that begins afterward.

name: Four of Swords
description: A needed pause for rest and recovery. Retreat now to restore the mind before facing what comes next.

name: Five of Swords
reversed: reconciliation, letting go of a fight
description: A win that costs more than it is worth. Conflict leaves everyone diminished, and the card asks what the fight was really for.

name: Six of Swords
description: A quiet crossing toward calmer waters. You are leaving trouble behind, carrying only what you must.

name: Seven of Swords
description: Sneaking away with a stolen advantage. It can mean cunning strategy, or deceit that may catch up to you.

name: Eight of Swords
description: Bound and blindfolded but not truly trapped. The restrictions are largely in the mind, and the way out is closer than it feels.

name: Nine of Swords
description: Sleepless worry in the dark hours. The fears feel enormous but are often larger in the mind than in reality.

name: Ten of Swords
description: A final, dramatic ending at rock bottom. It is painful, yet it also means the worst is over and dawn is coming.

name: Page of Swords
description: A sharp, curious mind eager to learn and question. This is the student who has not yet tested their ideas.

name: Knight of Swords
description: Charging in with fast thinking and fierce conviction. He gets results quickly but may trample nuance.

name: Queen of Swords
description: Clear-eyed, honest, and independent. She sees through pretense and speaks plainly, shaped by hard-won experience.

name: King of Swords
description: A master of reason, law, and truth. He decides with objective logic and expects the same standard from others.

name: Ace of Pentacles
upright: a new opportunity, a material seed
description: A seed of new prosperity, whether in work, money, or health. The opportunity is real and ready to be grown.

name: Two of Pentacles
description: Juggling competing demands with a steady rhythm. It shows flexibility and the skill of keeping things in motion.

name: Three of Pentacles
description: Skilled collaboration where each person adds their craft. Work is recognized and the result is greater than any one part.

name: Four of Pentacles
description: Clutching tightly to what you have. It brings security, but also the risk of fear and rigidity.

name: Five of Pentacles
description: Hardship and feeling left out in the cold. Help is nearby if you are willing to see it.

name: Six of Pentacles
description: Giving and receiving in balance. Generosity flows, and the card asks about fairness in how resources are shared.

name: Seven of Pentacles
description: Pausing to assess a garden you have tended. The harvest is not yet ripe, and patience is the lesson.

name: Eight of Pentacles
description: Dedicated craftsmanship and steady practice. Mastery is built one careful repetition at a time.

name: Nine of Pentacles
description: Enjoying independence and the fruits of your own labor. It is refined comfort that you earned yourself.

name: Ten of Pentacles
description: Lasting wealth, legacy, and family stability. It speaks to what is built to be passed down.

name: Page of Pentacles
description: A thoughtful student of the practical world. This card marks curiosity about a new skill, craft, or goal.

name: Knight of Pentacles
description: Slow, reliable, and thorough. He may not be fast, but he finishes what he starts.

name: Queen of Pentacles
description: Nurturing and grounded, creating warmth through practical care. She makes a home and sustains those around her.

name: King of Pentacles
description: A steady provider who has built lasting abundance. He leads with reliability, generosity, and good sense.
